payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Hello everyone, I'm Lawanna. I have 10 hours availability and my top skill is ui-ux-design (0.82). I'm interested in ISSUE-0001::implement (priority: high, effort: 2.0, my cost: 2.17). I can also take any other ISSUE-0001 task if needed. What are your skills and preferences?

Hi everyone, I'm Emil. Availability: 9.0. My top skills are data-science (0.84) and ui-ux-design (0.68). Lawanna, I'm happy to leave ISSUE-0001::implement to you. I'm considering taking ISSUE-0002::review (priority: high, effort: 4.0, my cost: 7.73) since I have a strong data-science skill, or I can pick up one of the other ISSUE-0001 tasks (docs, triage, review) which are lower cost for me. What are others thinking? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi everyone, I'm Raymond. My availability is 9.0 and my top skills are data-science (0.86) and documentation (0.81). Because of my skills, my costs for ISSUE-0002 tasks are quite low: review (4.29), test (6.01), and implement (8.59). Emil, I see you're interested in ISSUE-0002::review (cost 7.73); since my cost for that is 4.29, I could take that, or I could take the larger ISSUE-0002::implement (8.59) to make sure it gets done efficiently. What do Frida, Hipolito, and Lamont think? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raymond, since you have 9.0 availability, maybe you could handle the larger ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 8.0)? Emil, perhaps you or one of the others (Frida, Hipolito) could take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 5.6) or some of the ISSUE-0001 tasks? Lawanna, ISSUE-0001::implement sounds great for you.
